prompt: Build the Chinese internet meme character 大笑奶龙 (Laughing Nailong, also called 奶蛙) in 3D with three.js from memory, as it appears in the meme. No reference image is provided. Task (3D, static, from memory): write an HTML page that builds the character from code and renders it from your reference camera. For this static task, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>大笑奶龙</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:240px;height:240px;overflow:hidden;background:#f4eee3}
canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:240px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xf4eee3);
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240,240);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

function group(parent,name){
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
function material(color,roughness=.75){
  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness,side:THREE.DoubleSide});
}
const yellow=material(0xffcc32), dark=material(0x37201c), tongue=material(0xf07975);
const throat=material(0x66262c), ridge=material(0xf3ab29);
const dragon=group(scene,'Laughing Nailong');
const body=group(dragon,'round body'), head=group(dragon,'head');
const mouth=group(head,'laughing mouth'), eyes=group(head,'squeezed eyes');

function oval(parent,name,mat,x,y,z,a,b,c){
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,48,32),mat);
  mesh.name=name;
  mesh.position.set(x,y,z);
  mesh.scale.set(a,b,c);
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}
function patch(parent,name,mat,nu,nv,point){
  const pos=[],idx=[];
  for(let j=0;j<=nv;j++){
    for(let i=0;i<=nu;i++) pos.push(...point(i/nu,j/nv));
  }
  for(let j=0;j<nv;j++)for(let i=0;i<nu;i++){
    const a=j*(nu+1)+i,b=a+nu+1;
    idx.push(a,a+1,b,a+1,b+1,b);
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  geo.setIndex(idx);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,mat);
  mesh.name=name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

oval(body,'pear shaped belly',yellow,0,1.02,0,1.04,1.04,.81);
for(const s of [-1,1]){
  const leg=group(dragon,s<0?'left foot':'right foot');
  const foot=oval(leg,'stubby padded foot',yellow,s*.56,.235,.18,.43,.245,.49);
  foot.rotation.y=s*.16;
  const arm=group(dragon,s<0?'left arm':'right arm');
  arm.position.set(s*.87,1.37,.15);
  arm.rotation.z=s*.53;
  arm.rotation.x=-.31;
  oval(arm,'soft flipper',yellow,s*.05,-.19,.07,.235,.46,.245);
  const hand=group(arm,'hand');
  oval(hand,'rounded paw',yellow,s*.065,-.49,.13,.226,.23,.24);
}

const tail=group(body,'tail');
patch(tail,'tapering curved tail',yellow,56,48,(u,v)=>{
  const a=u*Math.PI*2, r=.48*Math.pow(1-v,.77);
  return [.32*v*v+r*Math.cos(a),.64-.22*Math.sin(Math.PI*v)+.21*v*v+r*Math.sin(a),-.43-1.07*v];
});

// The head surface and the mouth share both lip contours.
const limit=1.035;
function lips(a){
  const f=Math.max(0,1-(a/limit)**2);
  return [2.36-.62*f**.80,2.36+.13*f+.055*Math.sin(Math.PI*f)];
}
function skin(a,y){
  const h=(y-2.30)/.91;
  const r=Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-h*h));
  const front=Math.max(0,Math.cos(a));
  const muzzle=.255*Math.exp(-((y-2.46)**2)/.086)*front**2;
  return [Math.sin(a)*1.14*r*(1-.10*h),y,
    .02+Math.cos(a)*.87*r+muzzle];
}
for(const [start,end,front] of [[-Math.PI,-limit,false],[-limit,limit,true],[limit,Math.PI,false]]){
  for(let part=0;part<2;part++){
    patch(head,part?'crown and muzzle':'lower cheeks',yellow,64,36,(u,v)=>{
      const a=start+(end-start)*u;
      const [low,high]=front?lips(a):[2.36,2.36];
      const y=part?high+(3.21-high)*Math.sin(v*Math.PI/2):
        low-(low-1.39)*Math.cos(v*Math.PI/2);
      return skin(a,y);
    });
  }
}
function oral(u,v){
  const a=(2*u-1)*limit,[lo,hi]=lips(a);
  const p=skin(a,lo+(hi-lo)*v);
  p[2]-=.30*Math.sin(Math.PI*u)**.85*Math.sin(Math.PI*v)**.75;
  return p;
}
patch(mouth,'deep open grin',throat,96,40,oral);
patch(mouth,'pink tongue curled inside lower lip',tongue,72,18,(u,v)=>{
  const s=.135+.73*u;
  const f=Math.sin(Math.PI*u);
  const h=.088+.13*f;
  const p=oral(s,h+(.16*v-.076)*f**.62+.040*f*Math.sin(Math.PI*v));
  p[2]+=.013+.036*f*Math.sin(Math.PI*v);
  return p;
});

function stroke(parent,name,mat,points,radii){
  const path=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points.map(p=>new THREE.Vector3(...p)));
  const n=48,frames=path.computeFrenetFrames(n,false);
  patch(parent,name,mat,16,n,(u,v)=>{
    const j=Math.round(v*n),p=path.getPointAt(v);
    const a=u*Math.PI*2,r=radii(v);
    p.addScaledVector(frames.normals[j],r*Math.cos(a));
    p.addScaledVector(frames.binormals[j],r*Math.sin(a));
    return p.toArray();
  });
}
for(const s of [-1,1]){
  const eye=group(eyes,s<0?'left eye':'right eye');
  const points=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=8;i++){
    const t=i/8;
    const p=skin(s*(.23+.44*t),2.733+.102*Math.sin(Math.PI*t)-.032*t);
    p[2]+=.017;
    points.push(p);
  }
  stroke(eye,'arched closed eyelid',dark,points,t=>.004+.037*Math.sin(Math.PI*t)**.55);
  const p=skin(s*.135,2.565);
  const nostril=oval(head,'nostril',ridge,p[0],p[1],p[2]+.003,.033,.017,.013);
  nostril.rotation.z=-s*.30;
}
for(const [y,z,size] of [[2.89,-.55,.16],[2.60,-.77,.16],[2.27,-.84,.15],[1.94,-.79,.13],[1.58,-.68,.11]]){
  const bump=oval(body,'small dorsal bump',ridge,0,y,z,.115,size,size);
  bump.rotation.x=-.25;
}

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffbef,0xffdeb5,1.85));
function lamp(x,y,z,color,power){
  const light=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,power);
  light.position.set(x,y,z);
  scene.add(light);
}
lamp(-3,5,4,0xfff7e7,2.05);
lamp(4,2,2,0xffefdf,.60);
lamp(1,3,-4,0xfff5cf,1.38);
const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1.85,1.85,1.85,-1.85,.1,30);
ref.position.set(.74,2.26,7.3);
ref.lookAt(0,1.61,0);
function render(t){renderer.render(scene,ref);}
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[dragon],render,ready:true};
render(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
